name: Senoo Yuuko
source:
The tightest screw at the school. Her only joy seems to come from chiding students for every little violation. That's probably why she's the gym teacher, so she can inflict physical punishment on an entire wayward generation.

[From [url=http://www.ign.com/faqs/2006/sensei-2-walkthrough-adult-title-733648]Ben Woodhouse's Sensei 2 Walkthrough[/url]]
